## Sheets: weekly pipeline snapshot (build 5)
Mondays 08:00 Manila. Every open deal in **TCA new business** becomes one row in the **Pipeline snapshot** tab of the Leads sheet: date, deal id, deal, stage, owner, score, bucket, days in stage, created.

- Written RAW (never read as formulas), in one append call.
- If this week's date is already in the tab, nothing is added, so a re-run is safe.
- Plan: `docs/HUBSPOT_PLAN.md`, build 5.
